source_title: Cline mobile: how to vibe code from your phone
claim_summary: Vendor how-to describes reaching the Cline Kanban board on a home Mac from a phone via Tailscale and a host setting that exposes the board on the network.
feature: remote access to local agent board
availability: usage guide; no new release named
limitation: Exposing the local Kanban server beyond loopback interacts with the WebSocket origin flaw later disclosed as CVE-2026-44211 (CI2026-023-007); no security review of the recipe performed.

claim_summary: Release notes add Claude Opus 4.7 support, Azure Blob Storage as a storage provider and remote-config globalSkills, and list a fix for an 'action injection security risk'.
feature: model support; enterprise remote config; security fix
limitation: One-line security note has no advisory, CVE or affected-version range; Marketplace/Open VSX rollout timing not checked.

source_title: Cross-Origin WebSocket Hijack in Cline Kanban Server
claim_summary: Critical advisory (CVE-2026-44211): kanban server on 127.0.0.1:3484 accepted WebSocket connections without Origin checks, allowing any visited website to read workspace/task data, inject prompts into agent terminals and kill sessions.
availability: advisory published; GitHub/GitLab records list affected cline <= 2.13.0 and no patched version
limitation: No first-patched version named in GitHub or GitLab advisory records as of 2026-10-16; whether the SDK-based CLI 3.x line is unaffected is not stated. NVD page not machine-readable here.

claim_summary: Release notes introduce a new Cline CLI built on the new SDK with a new TUI, installable via npm install -g cline.
availability: GitHub release published 2026-05-12T22:29:54Z (one day before SDK blog)
limitation: Artifact of the same SDK launch family as CI2026-023-001; not an independent confirmation. npm package provenance/attestation not checked.

source_title: Introducing Cline SDK: the upgraded agent runtime, and we rebuilt Cline upon it
claim_summary: Cline announced an embeddable agent runtime extracted from its IDE product.
availability: vendor SDK introduction; versioned npm/GitHub reproduction not run
limitation: No tested pin/license/provenance for a specific install in this study. QC 2026-10-16: page names no licence (Apache-2.0 is from GitHub repo metadata); page states VS Code/JetBrains migration still in progress, so 'shipped' covers SDK/CLI only, not the IDE extensions (SDK extension first shipped 2026-06-26, rolled back, then staged to 100% by 2026-08-23 per vendor).

source_title: Extending the Cline loop with plugins and hooks
claim_summary: Publisher shows plugin hooks for agent tool calls and lifecycle event handlers.
availability: Vendor example, not independently pinned/tested package behavior.
limitation: Regex examples are not a security sandbox; exact SDK package/version needed. QC 2026-10-16: sitemap lastmod 2026-07-29 indicates later edits after the displayed 2026-06-15 date; VS Code plugin availability depended on the SDK-extension rollout (v4.0.0 then rollback).

source_title: Cross-Origin WebSocket Hijacking in Cline Hub Dashboard (/browser endpoint)
claim_summary: High advisory (CVE-2026-59723): cline dashboard Hub accepted cross-origin WebSockets on /browser without Origin checks when ROOM_SECRET was unset (local default), and dashboard sessions defaulted to auto-approve, enabling settings mutation and command execution.
feature: local Hub origin validation; auto-approve defaults
availability: advisory published; GitHub-reviewed record names first patched cline 3.0.30
limitation: Affected range differs between records (repo advisory: <= 3.0.24; GitHub global DB: < 3.0.30); fix not independently tested.

claim_summary: Release notes move the VS Code extension onto the shared Cline SDK session layer and add ClinePass, a Customize marketplace for Skills/MCP/Plugins, queued prompts; command auto-approval disabled by default; subagents temporarily disabled.
feature: SDK-backed extension runtime; plugins marketplace; safer auto-approval default
availability: GitHub release 2026-06-26; superseded by rollback 4.0.1 on 2026-06-28
limitation: Reverted two days later (CI2026-023-010); user regression reports exist in the issue tracker; feature claims not exercised here.

claim_summary: Release notes roll the stable extension back to the pre-SDK 3.89.2 code under a higher version number to resolve regressions reported in 4.0.0; SDK migration continues on main.
limitation: Regression count/severity not quantified by vendor; user issue reports are unverified individual reports.

source_title: ClinePass, Best of Value for Open-Weight models
claim_summary: Vendor announces ClinePass, a $9.99/month subscription pairing Cline's harness with curated open-weight models and 2-5x standard API rate limits.
limitation: Sitemap lastmod 2026-07-16 indicates later edits; rate-limit and value claims not verified; plan terms not reviewed.

claim_summary: Release notes call this the first public release of Cline Code for macOS, a desktop app for running and inspecting agent sessions, signed/notarized, with auto-updates.
limitation: Earlier than the 2026-09-14 Desktop announcement (CI2026-023-004); one aggregator dates first public release to v0.0.4, a conflict not resolved beyond the GitHub record. Signing/notarization not verified.

source_title: Recursive Self Improvement for Coding Agents
claim_summary: Cline reported optimizing a coding-agent harness and a Terminal-Bench score.
limitation: Task selection, contamination, model/provider and energy boundaries not independently audited.

claim_summary: Release notes ship one VSIX with legacy and SDK-based extensions plus a loader that activates one per window under a remotely controlled staged rollout starting at 1%, with automatic fallback to legacy on activation failure.
limitation: Rollout percentages are vendor-controlled and not externally observable; telemetry-based assignment not reviewed for privacy.

claim_summary: Release notes remove model-initiated plan-to-act switching and hard-block file-editing shell commands, mutating git subcommands and package installs in plan mode instead of relying on prompting.
limitation: Blocking completeness not tested; a command classifier can miss edge cases.

claim_summary: Vendor publishes dozens of eval run traces and hill-climbing scores for open-weight agents on a hosted ledger site.
availability: hosted data page; no code repository or licence stated
limitation: No licence stated; trace selection and completeness not audited; hosted site (netlify) not opened.

source_title: Building a code review agent on the Cline loop
claim_summary: Vendor tutorial builds a code review agent (review pass plus stricter judge pass, guardrails, audit logging, custom finding tools) with @cline/sdk.
limitation: Self-judging review loop is not independent acceptance; review quality not measured.

claim_summary: Release notes redact credentials embedded in git remote URLs from workspace info sent to the model, fix hook workspace resolution across windows, cap the hub event log, and hide no-op per-tool MCP auto-approve checkboxes.
feature: credential redaction; hooks; MCP approval UI
limitation: Vendor states the per-tool MCP auto-approve checkboxes were no-ops before this release; redaction coverage not tested.

source_title: How We Migrated 11 Million Users to Cline's Biggest Harness Upgrade
claim_summary: Vendor retrospective: first SDK migration attempt was rolled back; loader-based percentage rollout via a feature flag reached 100% as of August 23 with automatic legacy fallback.
limitation: '11 million users' is a vendor figure (May post said 'over 7m developers'); user counts are not verified adoption; sitemap lastmod 2026-09-04 indicates edits.

source_title: Cline Desktop: An open-source app for open-weight models
claim_summary: Publisher describes early Desktop app with parallel agent sessions and optional open-weight models.
availability: Early release and Windows beta per vendor; untested externally.
limitation: Vendor benchmarks are not independently reproduced; installation/compatibility unknown. QC 2026-10-16: GitHub release desktop-v0.0.2 (2026-07-22) was already a first public macOS release, so 2026-09-14 is the announcement/Windows-beta date, not first availability (see CI2026-023-011); quoted Terminal-Bench scores are CLI-harness results.

product: Cline VS Code extension / JetBrains core
claim_summary: Release notes fix Windows workspace executable hijack: a repository file named rg.exe, git.exe or powershell.exe could run instead of the real program when the workspace was indexed; Cline now sets NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath.
limitation: No GHSA/CVE found in the repository advisory list for this fix; affected-version range not stated.

claim_summary: Release notes run same-step sub-agent tool calls concurrently, raise default output budgets for large-output models, and fix a regression where UserPromptSubmit/TaskStart hook context was silently dropped.
feature: parallel sub-agents; hook context regression fix
limitation: Vendor notes default-model changes for 36 providers without pinned models (reproducibility risk); performance/cost effects not measured.

claim_summary: Release notes add a /compact command and make Connectors the default Customize tab, with a rollout notice when an account lacks beta access.
availability: GitHub release 2026-10-02; connectors gated by beta access
limitation: Beta access criteria not public; connector security not reviewed.

claim_summary: Release notes make Generate Commit Message follow .clinerules, page oversized MCP tool output via read_files, fix approve/reject races, and fix a 4.1.22 regression breaking custom Anthropic base URLs.
limitation: Fixes a regression introduced one release earlier; model-catalog default changes affect unpinned setups.
